projects.title: Context-Aware Candidate Ranking Pipeline | India AI Hiring Challenge
projects.description:
Engineered a Two-Stage Hybrid AI architecture to replace rigid boolean ATS keyword filters with a mathematically grounded semantic search system, evaluating candidates on true trajectory and implicit capabilities.

Architected a broad dense retrieval infrastructure utilizing a BAAI/bge-m3 Bi-Encoder and a Qdrant Vector Database to dynamically parse and embed over 10,000 nested JSON candidate profiles into a highly searchable vector space.

Deployed a Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B Cross-Encoder to simultaneously evaluate complex job descriptions and candidate histories, utilizing self-attention mechanisms to generate explainable AI confidence logit scores.

Optimized the pipeline for production scalability on local NVIDIA GPUs by engineering memory-safe inference protocols, including strict mini-batching, dynamic eos_token padding, and explicit VRAM garbage collection to prevent Out-Of-Memory (OOM) crashes.

Delivered a fully functional, end-to-end Python codebase that slashed screening time to seconds, outputting a highly precise and unbiased top 100 talent shortlist.

hackathons.title: Prompt Wars Challenge 4
hackathons.description:
As a Lead Architect & Full-Stack Developer, my goal was to engineer a live solution capable of handling real-time crowd dynamics and multilingual fan assistance at scale. 
Here is a look at what powers the application:
⚙️ Tech Stack & Architecture: 
🔹 Backend: Java 21 & Spring Boot 3.x for a robust, high-performance API. 
🔹 Database: Supabase with PostgreSQL for relational mapping, and pgvector for storing rich GenAI embeddings.
🔹 Authentication: Supabase Auth with custom role-based JWTs mapping directly to Spring Security for strict endpoint protection (e.g., isolating Staff from Fans). 
🔹 Frontend: A clean, responsive Vanilla JS/CSS architecture generated dynamically using Stitch MCP components. 
🔹 AI/RAG: A Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) assistant for fans that searches stadium maps and transit data to answer questions seamlessly in multiple languages. 
🔹 DevOps: Fully Dockerized, Kubernetes-ready, and deployed live on Render with PgBouncer connection pooling.
